technical_debt.executive_summary: The technical debt assessment identified 13 production-source complexity findings across the analyzed repository. Significant production themes: Deep nesting, Excessive branching, Excessive parameters, Large callables, and Oversized types/modules. These map to 9 production-facing conclusions. Inventory presentation includes 10 of 10 production hotspots (ordered by severity, finding count, then path — not a priority score). The assessment is based on static complexity evidence and does not include composite debt scores, financial estimates, or remediation-hour claims.
technical_debt.hotspot_presentation_note: Hotspots are shown in inventory order (highest severity, then finding count, then path/unit). This is presentation order, not a priority score.

key_metrics.label: Production hotspots shown
key_metrics.note: 10 production hotspots in inventory (presentation order, not priority).

limitations.summary: Business impact remains unknown for repository-only technical debt assessment without explicit enterprise context.
JavaScript and TypeScript complexity metrics are unsupported in Phase 4.3; only Python and Java collectors are available.
No engineering-hours, staffing, or schedule estimate is produced by this assessment section.
No financial cost, interest-rate, or dollar estimate is computed for technical debt.
Paths under .codestrata/ and other shared ignore markers are excluded from complexity measurement.
Cognitive complexity is not measured. Branch-point counts are structural keyword/operator counts, not certified cyclomatic products.
Technical debt findings are based on static repository evidence. Runtime behavior and productivity loss are not observed.
